description: Use this when the user wants to convert a raster image (logo, icon, illustration, scan, screenshot; PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF, TIFF) into a vector: SVG, PDF, EPS, DXF or a re-rendered PNG. Pass the image in exactly one way: image (a file attached to the chat message, ChatGPT), upload_id (from create_upload) or image_base64 (≤2 MB, only exact file bytes you already have as text). If none of these is available, for example an image attached in Claude.ai, call open_editor instead. Returns a download link per format, valid 24 hours (or retention_days), and the SVG inline when small. Uses 1 credit for all formats; mode=test is free and watermarked; mode=preview is a free PNG up to 1 MP whose link buys the vectors later (format=svg, 1 credit). Do not use for generating new images, editing photos or upscaling.

adobe_compat.description: true: SVG friendly to Adobe Illustrator (size always set, stroke widths in drawing coordinates).

align_x.description: Horizontal placement on the sheet, 0 left … 1 right (default 0.5). Needs width and height; not with aspect=stretch.

align_y.description: Vertical placement on the sheet, 0 top … 1 bottom (default 0.5). Needs width and height; not with aspect=stretch.

aspect.description: With both width and height: fit (default, whole drawing inside), fill (covers the sheet, excess cropped), stretch (exact size, distorted).

colors.description: Number of colors: 'auto', 'unlimited', or an integer 2–32 (max_colors goes up to 256). Default auto.

corners.description: Keep corners sharp or round them.

curve_tolerance.description: Curve fitting tolerance in source pixels (default ≈0.5): lower keeps more nodes. Also sets smoothness unless given.

curves.description: all: curves and lines; lines: straight segments only; lines_arcs: DXF lines and arcs, other formats as lines.

denoise.description: Noise reduction before tracing: 0 off … 3 strongest.

detail.description: Output detail for photos. Default auto.

dpi.description: Pixels per inch of PNG output; needs a size in pt, mm, cm or in. Default 300.

draw.description: fill: filled shapes; stroke: outline of every shape; stroke_edges: only the borders between shapes, each once (no double cuts). Default from the preset.

dxf_curves.description: DXF curves as lines (polylines, default), arcs or splines. curves=lines/lines_arcs wins.

format.description: Output formats; several formats cost 1 credit together. Default: the preset's format (svg for web).

gap_filler.description: on: an underlay in the shape colors hides light gaps between shapes. Needs draw=fill. Default off.

gap_filler_width.description: Gap filler width in source pixels (default 1). Needs gap_filler=on.

group_by.description: Groups in the output: color (one per color) or layer (by nesting depth). SVG <g>, PDF layers, EPS blocks, DXF layers. Default: by color only for layers=cutouts_grouped (DXF always by color).

height.description: Physical output height in unit (width follows the aspect ratio unless width is set too).

image.description: Image file attached to the user's message in the chat (ChatGPT).

image_base64.description: Exact PNG/JPEG/WebP/BMP/GIF/TIFF file bytes in base64 (≤2 MB), only when you already have them as text (e.g. from reading the file in a terminal). Never transcribe an image you only see in the conversation; call open_editor instead. Use create_upload for larger files.

image_type.description: Kind of image: artwork with smooth (anti-aliased) edges, artwork with hard pixel edges, or photo. Default auto.

layers.description: Shapes stacked on top of each other, cut out of each other, or cut out and grouped by color. Default from the preset.

max_colors.description: Maximum number of colors (2–256). Not combined with colors or palette.

max_pixels.description: Downscale the input to at most this many pixels before tracing (faster, fewer nodes).

min_area.description: Smallest shape kept, in px²; smaller specks are dropped. Overrides the preset.

mode.description: test: free, watermarked result for building an integration. preview: free PNG up to 1 MP without watermark, no vectors; fetch its link with format=svg to buy the vectors for 1 credit. Neither is available for vectorize_url. Default live.

palette.description: Fixed colors #rrggbb (2–256), as a list or a comma-separated string. Not combined with colors or max_colors.

palette_tolerance.description: With palette: how far (CIE76 ΔE) an image color may be from a palette color to snap to it; farther colors keep their own value.

png_antialias.description: Anti-aliasing in PNG output. Default on.

preset.description: Settings for the job: web (default), print (PDF, shapes cut out), cut (vinyl/stickers, 8 colors), laser (2-color outlines), embroidery (12 colors, no tiny shapes).

quality.description: Input quality: low for blurry/noisy/JPEG-heavy images. Default auto.

retention_days.description: Keep the result downloadable for this many days (default 24 hours). Live mode only.

scale.description: Output size as a multiple of the source size. Not with width/height.

stroke_color.description: Stroke color #rrggbb instead of the shape color; needs draw=stroke or stroke_edges.

stroke_scaling.description: fixed (default): width stays in output units when resized; scale: width in source pixels scales with the drawing.

stroke_width.description: Stroke width; needs draw=stroke or stroke_edges. Output units, or source pixels with stroke_scaling=scale. Default: hairline.

svg_fixed_size.description: true (default): width/height on the root <svg>; false: only a viewBox (responsive).

svg_version.description: SVG flavor: 1.1 (default), 1.0, or tiny1.2 (no opacity or gradient transforms).

transparency.description: Transparent areas: keep (stay transparent), white, or a background color #rrggbb.

unit.description: Unit for width/height: px (default), pt, mm, cm, in.

upload_id.description: ID returned by create_upload after the file was uploaded.

width.description: Physical output width in unit. With width only, the height follows the aspect ratio; with height too, a sheet of that size (see aspect). Up to 10 m.

name: vectorize

download_url.description: Link to the first requested format.

free_remaining_today.description: Free MCP vectorizations left today (used before credits).
